name: Electra
description: The bright sunlight shines on the small island of Arsinoe. Some secrets, betrayals, and crimes are revealed. The mirror has somehow turned upside down. Sotiris, who was let down by those closest to him, will go from being a victim to becoming a perpetrator.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Electra is suffocating in her narrow minded island community. Pavlos Philippou, a charming man, arrives in Arsinoe. Electra senses this man holds the key to her freedom. But freedom always comes at a price.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: What dark secret is Pavlos hiding and why is he afraid of the friendly chat the gendarmerie commander wants to have with him?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Nikolas turns out to be dangerous for everyone! His father, Petros Vrettos, humiliates him in front of the harbour workers. What does a key have to do with the fire that breaks out in his father's shipyard?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Vasilis' family invites Pavlos to dinner. And on this occasion, his glance hurts Electra deeply. Because she knows. He stood up for what was right and she stood up for what was wrong, covering for Nikolas.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Summer is coming to a close and Electra and her daughters go for one last swim. On the beach they meet Pavlos, who continues to pursue Electra, as the two of them enter a secluded cave!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Meropi is suspicious of Pavlos' communist ideology and goes through his things. What does she find there? Electra secretly meets with him again, saying that whenever she sees him, she is afraid. What exactly is this fear he awakens in her?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Due to the findings, Sotiris and Electra are almost lynched in the square, until Pavlos intervenes and helps them.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sotiris discovers that Electra is secretly taking the horse, while he has forbidden her to. His reaction is so extreme that it changes everything!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Popi discovers the family’s great secret, which threatens to throw them all off balance. But this is not the only secret she has discovered.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Katerina agrees to meet with Nikolas but she immediately sees through his lies. But is that enough to keep her away from him?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: What's going on with Popi after all? What does Nikolas have to do with her disappearance and why is his shirt stained with blood?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Vasilis tries to get back together with Ourania, but the circumstances and also Popi, who is one of his exes, are far from favorable.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The Commander is circling Nikolas menacingly, but stumbles upon the alibi that Electra has given Nikolas for the night of the fire. To confirm his suspicions, he approaches Stergios, hoping to find out if Electra is covering for her brother-in-law.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Stergios fears that the Police Commander will discover the false alibi that Electra gave Nikolas on the night of the fire and that she’ll get into trouble.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Before leaving the island, Popi has a farewell meeting with Vasilis who gets out of control and the truths hurled at each other put a strain on both of them.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Electra goes to the river with Pavlos and the two share a passionate kiss. Electra returns home upset while Sotiris is puzzled by her strange behavior.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Nikolas goes to the bank to collect the shipyard’s security money and is attacked by “robbers”.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Charis puts a plan in place to get to the shipyard arsonist. Will he finally be able to solve the mystery before things get even more complicated?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Electra is so entranced by Pavlos that she does not realize that Sotiris is suspecting her. That's why he breaks open the drawer with her hidden diary...

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Electra is shocked by Sotiris' revelation that he has read her diary. Has he read about a secret illegal matter?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Nikolas secretly meets with Katerina and puts his plan into action: he begins to distort the way she sees her sister. Nontas finds himself in prison once again, while at the shipyard, Vassilis demands that Nikolas leave Katerina alone.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Vrettos conspires with Charis to set a plan in motion to discover the culprit of the arson. Will they succeed or will things get more complicated?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Electra decides to take a daring step forward, after receiving a special birthday present from Pavlos. But will it prove to be a step towards freedom... or utter destruction?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Nikolas pressures Katerina to leave the island with him. She resists. Will he persuade her? How do the Vrettos family react after Electra's relentless attack?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Zoi, along with Nontas and the others decide to help Pavlos escape. But the Commander has been informed about the incident at the school and is stalking them. This time around, Pavlos will not escape arrest!

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A clause in Vrettos' will causes Nikolas to become enraged and his relationship with his father goes from bad to worse.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Vasilis tries to convince Pavlos to let them help him run away, but after Electra reveals she has used him romantically, he has no power to do anything... it’s as though he has turned himself in already.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: With the inspector in Arsinoi, the net is tightening around Pavlos minute by minute. Electra, weary, arrives at his door. Can he bring himself to refuse to see her?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Nikolas tries to convince Katerina to come away with him to England. Domna drinks, unable to bear it. Feeling light-headed, she misses something on Sergios that she should never have missed in her whole life.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: How can a father stand on his feet when he learns what Stergios learned? His conversation with Domna was harsh. His conversation with Electra was unbearable. How could Electra bear the fact that he also learned the truth?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Pavlos demands to know from Electra why she wants to harm her husband's brother. What has this man really done to her?

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Filio walks through the door of the police station and admits where Nikolas really was on the night of the fire. The chief of police captures the beaten Nikolas whom he caught in the act of violently assaulting Filio.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The commander asks for Nikolas' fingerprint, to see if it matches the fingerprint on the bottle. The identification will plainly prove that he was the one who set the fire! Nikolas is in a panic! What will he do?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: The information that Nikolas may be the culprit for the arson quickly spreads across the village. Vrettos tells him bluntly: If true, he will kill him with his bare hands. Behind bars, Nikolas realizes that he is out of options.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Nikolas, in panic, tries to escape through the hospital window using a rope. Will he make it or will he get caught?

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Nikolas, blaming his father and brother for the abandonment he felt, wants to leave the island, while Filio walks through the door of the police station.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Pavlos' transfer is just around the corner, Electra and Pavlos must say their final goodbyes...

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Electra finds Pavlos packing a suitcase. She asks him to stay. But it is too late to cancel the transfer, the new teacher is already on his way ... What will he do?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Because of his transfer, Pavlos' file of evidence is opened, revealing that he is not the real Pavlos Filippou. The danger of ending up in exile is more imminent than ever!

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The inspector meets with Perlepes and also with Sotiris. What does he have to say about Mr. Filippou? Will he cover for him again this time?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Sotiris announces to Electra that they will go on a ten day trip to Athens, while Nikolas comes up with yet another plan to mislead everyone about Poppy's disappearance.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Sotiris announces to Electra that they will go on a ten day trip to Athens, while Nikolas comes up with yet another plan to mislead everyone about Poppy's disappearance.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Ourania and Vassilis finally meet at church. But there, while the ceremony has begun, their furious parents also meet. Will the wedding be completed?

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Sotiris asks Haris to keep an eye on Pavlos' moves. And Haris, in turn, asks him to find Popi in Athens. She gives him her address.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Perlepes informs Sotiris about the letter he found. Electra meets with Pavlos. She fears that sooner or later the entire island will know about them. She says goodbye to him and leaves. She and her husband arrive in Athens.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Vrettos reveals to Nikolas his plan for Seraftinoglou while the latter keeps an envelope with some proof that could harm Nikolas.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: The two guys following Pavlos prepare for a shootout at the hotel where he is staying. But Electra is in the room with him!

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Sotiris returns to their hotel, but he does not find Electra there. A bit later, at another hotel, Pavlos whispers to her while she looks at him in horror: "Don't go out. No matter what you hear." A moment later, a gunshot is heard.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Electra looks with horror at Pavlos, who is beaten. The unknown man lies bleeding. Pavlos asks Electra to return to the island immediately.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Sotiris buys psychiatric drugs for Electra. Why had she had to take such medication before?

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Electra finds the pills that Sotiris eventually bought for her, despite her refusal. She puts them in Sotiris' tea. And she runs out into the night.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Pavlos learns that his sister is probably dead! How will he react to this tragic news? Who else knows?

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: 1973 begins with the confirmation of two deaths: Poppy’s and Dina’s, Pavlos' sister. Charis keeps Poppy's death a secret to frame her killer. Pavlos is inconsolable.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Electra tries to convince Filio not to marry Nikolas. At the same time, Katerina accidentally learns that the salary for her job at the café is paid by her mother and this causes her to clash violently with Domna.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Electra has a big fight with Sotiris who raises his hand to hit her! Filio learns from her mother that Popi was killed but she must not tell anyone because the investigation is ongoing.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Pavlos insists on pushing Electra to leave together, even to Meropi's house, in front of everyone and especially before Sotiris' surprised eyes!

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Sotiris waits for the gendarmerie headquarters to sketch Stratis Danezis, believing him to be related to Pavlos. A fierce fight between Sotiris and Electra will make her think again about leaving with Pavlos...

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Konstantis becomes suspicious of Filippou and even reaches Sotiris who makes an unexpected proposal to the professor. What does he have in mind?

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Sotiris convinces Haris to sneak out to the pier of the port to catch Pavlos.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Everyone in Arsinoe is upset. Brigadier General Gkikas rules over the case and locks down the suspect for Popi's murder. Electra is drowned by remorse.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Electra connects some events by realizing that she saw Nikolas immediately after Popi's murder at the scene of the crime. She runs to tell the commander. Will this help?

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Stratis' sketch has reached the hands of the gendarmerie. Lawyer Nasos Dimaras, Pavlos' friend, arrives from Athens.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: A sad silence has covered Arsinoe like a veil. Sotiris dissolves sedatives in Electra's tea, Titika drags her step, the headlines talk about the "Dragon of Arsinoe".

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: The trial begins with Nasos unaware that someone informs Nikolas about his legal approach, and unfortunately in court he hears the last thing he ever wanted...

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Just before the final hearings in court and after all the witnesses have testified, a twist that no one expected takes place and changes everything in the trial!

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: In court, Danis frightens Giorgakis. He finally testifies but what he says once again changes the course of the trial!

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Nikolas receives the call to testify. His judgment day has arrived. What he doesn't know, however, is that Filio has secretly followed him to court, discovering that he continues to lie to her. How will he react?

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Nikolas tries to convince Filio not to testify to the truth, but she acts according to her conscience and testifies what she knows.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Nikolas manages to meet Vasilis and blackmails him. What is the ace hidden in Nikolas’ sleeve?

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Electra no longer fits into this world. Let this be her last move: the gun she raises. And she shoots. Three times. The only culprit. Nikolas.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: What plan did Electra have in mind when she shot Nikolas? Where do the Vrettos family suspicions turn? Titika turns to Domna, whom she visits...

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: The policemen sneak into the office and find the bug that contains all of Electra's conversation with Nikolas. Her guilt is now certain.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Electra goes to Pavlos’ house. She seems to be no longer interested in anything but living their love.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: The journalist tries in every way to convince Stergios to give an interview about Vassilis' innocence. But she doesn't tell him which newspaper she works for. Why does she persist so much? Is she hiding something?

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: The journalist asks for an interview with Nefeli and her sister. They meet at the square. As soon as the girls arrive, they see something shocking!

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: The Sagiades family is upset. But also the Vrettos family as well. Sotiris, in the midst of the new developments, tries to clarify Nefeli's feelings for Philippou.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Nikolas tries to regroup, thinking he will walk again. He makes his first visit to the shipyard since his injury.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Vassilis' lawyer tries to get him to tell the truth. He explains his plan for how he will manage to get released. But will Vassilis agree to follow it?

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Electra meets Pavlos in his dressing room. His reference to Nefeli's feelings brings great tension between them.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Electra meets Pavlos in his dressing room. His reference to Nefeli's feelings brings great tension between them.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Sotiris decides to stop Nefeli from taking private lessons especially in mathematics. This devastates her and worries Danai who fears how her sister will react.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Nefeli has indeed disappeared and everyone starts looking for her in fear. But they can't find her anywhere! In the heat of Nefeli's disappearance, Pavlos gets closer to Electra, thinking there is no one around to see them.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Maro reveals to Electra that she knows about her relationship with Pavlos. Soon after, she goes to the Vrettos family house and asks to speak with her son-in-law.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Telis manages to bring his father's second wife to his mother's shop to sing. He waits for the unsuspecting double-married Konstantis to come to the feast. And the party will be on fire...!

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Electra, in a stupor, goes to Pavlos' room. She screams at him that she knows what he is doing.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Domna meets Sotiris. She wonders if he keeps giving Electra pills in secret. He admits that he does. Athina has more bad news for the Arsinoe residents.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Meropi suspects that Pavlos is having an affair with Electra while Gina wants to denounce Konstantis for bigamy, which will land him in prison.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Konstantis understands by listening to all Popi's recordings, that Nikolas, Vasilis and their families fate lies in his hands. What is he thinking about? What will he end up doing?

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Nikolas returns and everyone is wondering: Where did he go all night? Konstantis departs, leaving Zoe behind to face this new reality.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Pavlos asks to leave school for a while to find Electra. He doesn't know, however, that Nefeli is following him.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Electra learns that Pavlos has spoken to Domna who has asked him to leave her daughter alone.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Everyone in Arsinoe is trying to redefine their relationships. Pavlos apologizes to Electra. On the other hand, Nontas asks Katerina to end their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Meropi accidentally learns that Sotiris was supplying sedatives for Electra. He tells Pavlos. How will he react?

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Sotiris tells Electra that it's all over with his family. And she replies that it's all over with hers too.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Vrettos, learning of Nikolas' plan for the inheritance, disinherits them along with Titika who knew everything! The brigadier general suddenly comes to the island. Is it because he is up to something that he arrived at this particular moment?

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Electra and her daughters are in the forest hut, thus putting in action her decision to divorce. There, she is confronted with the girls' tough questions and their revelations.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Nikolas requests to be taken to the shipyard. On the desk a bottle of whiskey. And a box of pills. And Poppy's tape recorder.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Haris makes a risky suggestion. Let the bastards approach Ourania so that they can catch them. It's their last chance.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Sotiris refuses to grant the divorce requested by Electra who collects things from the hut in the forest and returns to Sotiris.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Vrettos arrives at the forest hut with the intention of talking to Electra to reason her out. Instead, he finds her kissing. With Pavlos.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Vrettos buys a camera and has Kyriakos watch Pavlos and Electra to photograph them, proving their illicit affair. Will he come trumps up?

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Electra announces to the girls that she and Sotiris will proceed with a divorce. In the mean time, Pavlos is waiting in the little house in the forest for Electra, when Nefeli appears. How will he justify his presence?

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Haris along with Stergios and Mimis have hatched a plan to finally corner Nicolas.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Electra secretly meets Pavlos and while they quarrel again, they end up kissing. But they are not alone! Kyriakos has followed them with his camera!

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Electra visits Nikolas and pretends that she revealed to Danai the trick he did to get Sotiris out of the will. How will Nikolas react?

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: In prison, Vasilis discovers that his fellow inmates are setting up an escape plan .

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Nikolas continues to investigate Pavlos' past. Vrettos receives an unexpected visit from Domna, who decides to negotiate on her own terms.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Ourania with Markos and Nontas are determined to search the photo studio for clues. Telis and Sofia get in on the trick.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Katerina, who was looking at the shipyard for Poppy's tape recorder, found the photos of Pavlos kissing with her sister! She is shocked!

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Pavlos informs Electra of the warning she received and she begins to fear for his life.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: As Electra tries to gather her pieces, Achilleas' minion manages to locate Pavlos in Arsinoe!

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: "Stay," Pavlos whispers to Electra. Don't ever leave me again. When Electra returns home, Sotiris asks her where she was. To my lover, she answers.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: The escape begins. In panic, a guard finds Vasilis. There are shots. Blood! What happened, is Vasilis okay?

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Electra's decision to proceed with the divorce application leads Sotiris to the extremes.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Pavlos goes to the cabin in the woods to meet Electra. But who will he find inside, pointing a gun at him? And what about Nefeli? Why is she outside when the gunshot is heard?

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Nefeli is still trying to recover from the shock. Pavlos is anxious, as he fears that Nefeli will bend and everyone will learn their secret.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Stergios arrives at the hospital to meet Vrettos. The conversation between them will take an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Pavlos finds a way to secretly meet Nefeli. What does he ask of her? The next morning, Electra finds her daughter's bed empty. Where has Nefeli gone?

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Electra is about to go mad because Nefeli cries out for Pavlos: "He told me that he loves me as much as I love him!"

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: When Pavlos returns, before he can perceive Nefeli, Repanos manages to forcibly enter the room... demanding answers that Pavlos does not want to give. Nefeli ends up as a hostage in the hands of Repanos.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: At Zoe's shop, the group welcomes Stavros – without knowing his true identity. Nikolas presses Repanos to reveal his relationship with Achilleas.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Harry's visit to the hospital will cause Sotiris to learn about Nefeli's involvement in the Filippou-Repanos affair, a piece of information that will open the bag of Aeolus for Pavlos.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Electra arrives at Pavlos's dressing room and accuses him of manipulating her daughter. That same evening, Pavlos goes to dinner at Sotiris' house to explain what can be explained.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: "Do what you want," Pavlos cries out to Electra, "I don't care about anything anymore".

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: An old acquaintance arrives in Arsinoe: Orestis... But what does he have to do with Domna’s and Aliki's past? What is he doing in Arsinoe, is he settling old scores or opening new ones?

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Perlepes tells Sotiris that if Philippou is a traitor, it is their duty to expose him.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Orestis will receive, through Perlepes', a very important piece of information about Pavlos Filippou, a piece of information that helps him connect the pieces of the puzzle...

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Orestis informs Haris that no connection between Filippou and Repanos has been found. Is he telling the truth? Why does he then go to Electra's house? Why is he turning the debate to Mr.Filippou?

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Nefeli enters Pavlos' chamber dumbfounded. "We were discovered," she tells him breathlessly. Danae finds Katerina, demanding clear answers for Markos.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Nefeli begins to flirt with the idea of telling Orestis the truth. Will Pavlos be able to change her mind? Orestis searches the forest house, where he discovers traces of blood.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Electra, preparing things for their journey, reads in a notebook of Nefeli about her love for Pavlos. He tears the pages furiously.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Pavlos decides before taking his leave, to have a conversation with Perlepes, to whom he openly expresses his beliefs.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Vrettos decides to have an open conversation with Nikolas. What will he reveal to him and how will Nikolas pay for his mistakes?

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Orestis arrives at Sotiris' house. He informs him that yesterday he saw his daughter with Filippos and, apparently, they eloped. Electra cracks.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Electra is desperately searching for her daughter. But she's not alone in searching for the eloped couple: Orestis decides to interrogate Markos.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: In Arsinoi, Sotiris gives a clear order to the Commander: Once they find them, he wants them to bring them directly to the island. In front of him.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Stavros tries to find evidence against Nikolas, breaking into Serafetinoglou's house, with Mimis’ help. But when he is confronted by Serafetinoglou, things will not go as he had hoped...

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Sotiris is determined to take matters into his own hands and talk privately with Pavlos. What no one knows, however, is that Sotiris intends to conduct the conversation armed.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Orestis arrives at the Mayor's house at night and asks to speak alone with Sotiris. What he says won't please the mayor at all.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Electra and Pavlos at the edge of the cliff. In the riverbed. Where each saw each other for the first time. That's where it all started.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Nefeli’s confinement continues, but Pavlos does not intend to stand idle.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: The bride's car sets off for the church, while Ourania leaves her house upset. Why is she going towards the forest?

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Pavlos police sketch is making headlines and his life hangs in the balance: if one person recognizes Stratis Danezis, he will certainly be caught by the secret services.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Nefeli runs away and knocks on Pavlos' door in the middle of the night. She wears a beautiful dress, she has make up on, he opens the door and when he looks at her, he loses it. "I'm not a little girl, don't you see it? ", she tells him.

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Nefeli demands to learn the truth from Electra: did she tamper with Filippos' sketch to protect him? And why does she know his true identity? How can he trust her so much?

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Nontas throws a party in order to catch Markos and Katerina red-handed. True, when everyone leaves, Mark meets a woman and Nontas sees them: his brotherly friend, cuddling with his mother.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: Orestis is about to kill Pavlos, who has invited him to the Bouboulinas street building. Pavlos asks him to take a chair and sit down: "I've got a new deal for you!"

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Nefeli is unconscious, on the stretcher. Danae and Sotiris, panicked, arrive at the hospital. The doctor informs them that a transfusion must be done, her life is in danger. He asks the nurse to check Danae's blood type.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Sofia tries to find out the reason behind Nefeli's attempt. Nefeli replies that they were making fun of her. Sofia wonders: "the teacher... and who else?"

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Nefeli is not in the hospital. Danae gives blood again. Electra is running. Vrettos is clutching a tape in his hand. The tape. Nikola's hand raises a gun.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dawn. A thousand whispers over the small island. The stories of Arsinoe are making a comeback. But they're also capable of some pretty dark things.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A collection of words, truths, and bits and pieces of a life and a great love. A diary. Electra’s diary. The hands holding it are shaking. Like Stavros, who holds Ourania.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sotiris' wish for Nefeli's wedding. She'll try to forget in Pavlos' arms. But Electra can't, won't forget the man who betrayed her and condemned her to the greatest misery.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Electra signs the complaint with a shaking hand. "Did you tell them everything?" he asks her a few moments later. "The only thing I left out was how much of a coward you are!" Go away. Get lost."

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Electra is losing her grip on the world: the time has come to give her daughter away to Pavlos!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sotiris says to Nefeli and Pavlos, trying to convince himself that this marriage must happen, "Your love is strong, it has overcome all obstacles”. In a desperate attempt to prevent this union, Electra reveals who shot Nikolas.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Electra arrives at Pavlos house. With tears in her eyes. She asks him to get out of the wedding, to get out of here. He gives the final blow: "I am in love with Nefeli.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: "Whatever we had-if we had anything-is gone." Pavlos tries to bring his story to a close with Electra. She begins to lash out at him: "I hate you." Their bodies are in a state of struggle. But hating is not far from loving.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Fanouris is haunted by past memories, he drinks incessantly and decides to hurt the person who has hurt him, Aliki and his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Electra accompanies Nefeli to Athens to find a wedding dress. And when she sees her daughter as a bride, she gives her blessing! Did she change her mind due to her emotions, or does she have some ulterior motive?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The small island of Arsinoe has long lost its peace, and the results of Fanouris’ toxicology report will deliver yet another blow to its inhabitants. No one is safe.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Orestis, overwhelmed by the series of revelations, welcomes Bogris, who presents him with the victim. Who's going to foot the bill for the crime he himself committed?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Pavlos asks Electra to meet with him to discuss things in more detail. Meropi comes into Pavlos's dressing room just before Electra shows up. The bottle fragments are missing!

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: "I'm trying to forget! To leave it behind!" A suicide attempt that has become an open wound, with Electra and Pavlos fighting fiercely to save what can be saved from Nefeli's innocence.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Everyone knew about the mess, they planned it together"... These are the words that keep buzzing in Sotiris's head as he watches his father slowly die.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Electra and Pavlos are getting ready to propose to Nefeli. She says he's lost his way and his romanticism.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sotiris, reading an article in the newspaper that concerns him, gets upset and confronts Electra, whom he accuses of being the one who started it. Things get a bit out of control when Electra says, "I don't know who did it, but I'll find him... and I'll shake his hand."

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Electra is stuck in the cottage with Pavlos.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Nefeli is trying on her wedding dress for a final fitting before the big day. Electra can't even stand to look at her. Pavlos's kiss and what he said left her reeling. She heads to the small room, holding her bag. She's brought a gun with her.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Nefeli is on the brink of a major crisis. She's been struggling ever since she found out that Pavlos left... Electra is at a loss, seeing her little girl in this state. She promises Nefeli that she will find him.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: It's time for Nefeli and Pavlos' wedding! Bogris gives Agni a nudge: there's another wedding tomorrow, hers with her son Vrettos.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: "You don't have to do anything if you're not ready," Pavlos tells Nefeli on the first night of their wedding, but the young woman in love has other plans...

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: "You don't have to do anything if you're not ready," Pavlos tells Nefeli on the first night of their wedding, but the young woman in love has other plans...

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Sotiris has decided to spend the last days of their marriage with Electra in Primori to say goodbye. Is that what he's trying to do? If that's the case, why is he taking his gun with him?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Filio gets to the Gendarmerie and is ready to file a complaint against Nikolas and have him put back in jail. Titika's reaction is going to catch everyone off guard.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Nikolas is still standing at the scene of the fight, covered in blood, when Stavros and Ourania find him and can't believe their eyes. The whole island is searching for Vasilis, who is nowhere to be found. The doctor comes to Nikolas. Is he alive?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Vasilis is in a tricky position after Nikolas's attack and Ourania's conversation. He's back to drinking again.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The days go by, and then one day Nikolas turns up with the biggest surprise he could ever give to a person...

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: After her first sexual encounter with Pavlos, Nefeli opens her eyes gently. What's her concern? Why does she want to talk to her mum first? We've just heard that Electra is in a coma.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Electra and Sotiris try again. We went horseback riding on some routes we both know and love, but everything changed when Vrettos set fire to the cliff.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: The island of Arsinoe is once again in turmoil. Vrettos' car plunged into the ravine. It’s burnt and he's nowhere to be found. Orestis, in an effort to steer the investigation, officially calls upon Lazaros Deligiannis for assistance.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: A surprise is in store for Nikolas "Where the hell is your wife?" Titika asks him. Nikolas looks at her in confusion. I wonder where his dear Agni is? I'm wondering why she hasn't been back to the mansion since yesterday.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Vlasis approaches Pavlos. He reveals to him that he is a leftist, that he has knowledge of his past.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Vrettos is still nowhere to be found, and no one has any idea where he is. The suspicions shift from one person to the next. Michos, Deligiannis, Charis, Bogris, and Titika—all on top of the case. Unfortunately, Titika is broken and shattered into a thousand pieces.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Pavlos is standing in the middle of the staircase. Electra on the piano. "Let me come with you". The shadow of another life looms heavily over them.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: When Domna visits Electra, it really throws a wrench in Electra's marriage, and Sotiris goes to great lengths to make that happen. Pavlos hears a commotion, runs to help, and this brings him and Sotiris together in a tense situation.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Nikolas is desperate. His father and son are missing. And his mother is on the verge of collapse. He has to do something, he has to act. Furious, he arrives at Sotiris' house and finds them at dinner.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Sotiris thinks that Electra and Pavlos might be starting to wonder if he's serious about having them stay at his father's house. He asks Electra if he really wants them to stay. She's a bit shaken but confirms it.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Nikolas stands before himself, confronted with a realization. What has he overlooked? The truth strikes him like lightning: Sotiris knows who Danae's father is.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: "I don't think Sotitris is capable of murder," says Electra, but Lazaros finds something that will upset the whole Arsinoe...

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Now that Vrettos is dead, his will is finally being opened. But here's the catch: the will was changed three days before he disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: The shipyard's shares have been divided. Sotiris is furious. Both for the 25% he is entitled to, and for the trust that Vrettos leaves to Danai, setting Electra as manager.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Pavlos got lost in his thoughts and started drinking more and more, which upset Electra. "I don't care what happens to you, but I don't want my daughter to see you in this mess. So speak up, tell me, whatever you have to say..."

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Electra makes one last attempt to find out: "What has happened at last?! Will you tell me? You know that you can trust me, talk to me!” But Pavlos remains silent…something dark and gruesome weighs on the professor's conscience.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Charis and Mimis have more and more doubts about the closure of the Vrettos case. "Is this how we are going to end it?" Mimis wonders. "As an accident?" Charis makes a decision that changes everything...

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Electra paints, as if each brushstroke is the beginning of her new life unfolding in Athens. In Arsinoe, Pavlos feels like he doesn’t quite fit in Nefeli's arms.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Vassilis gets closer to Ourania, which angers Stavros, who decides to hold Ourania accountable.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Kyriakos shows up at the police station with a bobbin in his hand. "I've got the evidence you need right here. You must reopen the Vrettos case!" announces to the stunned Charis.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Soritis raises his glass: "Let us end our common life with truths." Electra's eyes are filled with fear.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: A simple but well-laid plan will awaken once again the demons of Vassilis and send Ourania into the arms of Stavros...

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: As time goes by, Vassilis finds himself in a tragic situation. The minister arrives on the island, and everyone is on high alert as the tour begins. Pavlos makes his way to the shipyard, but an impending explosion will occur, leaving indelible scars on our heroes.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Nefeli is concerned that Pavlos might be facing some difficulties. She decides to drop by Vlasis's place to sort things out, unaware that the house is being watched

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Pavlos threatens Deligiannis that if he does not release the two boys, everyone will know who is buried in Vrettos' grave.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Sotiris isn't helping Perlepes' son, even though the two boys are still at the police station. Telis is going to have to pay up first, since Deligiannis has his hands on him.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: In a game of chess, Deligiannis and Bogris decide the fate of Vlasis. So, who's going to make the checkmate move?

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Agni convinces Nikolas to go for a walk. She prepares a drink, especially for Titika, and they leave. Soon, a man enters the house.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Sotiris learns the truth about Alkis' past and apologizes to Electra for his suspicion. Alkis, he says, is innocent. But what is the truth, and what is a lie? Or maybe everything is a lie, and Ilektrá is entangled in a web of dishonor and exploitation?

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Electra paints a haunting image: a cave, a man, and a woman. Gasping, she turns to Pavlos and whispers, "We should never have left there," leaving him completely bewildered.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Pavlos decides to talk openly to Electra about her new freedoms. But as they talk, their lips draw closer. 'Tell me I'll be able to forget you,' she whispers. "Tell me." She looks at him breathlessly.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Agni continues with her plans, but Nikolas' mind has begun to recover and the stakes are high. "I don't know if I'll wake up one morning with a bouquet of flowers at my side or I will be strangled," she confesses to Bogris.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Stavros takes a bold step and decides to propose to Ourania. But Telis and Sophia are determined to stop him—will they succeed?

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: In Athens, Electra is living her dream and feels overwhelmed by it all. Her thoughts keep drifting back to a conversation with Nefeli: "Mom, I’m late..."

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Electra seems to embrace happiness at last, but Sotiris is gradually being consumed by his inner darkness...

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Tonight promises to be a long one for the small island of Arsinoe. "Let tonight pass, Zoi, and everything will fall into place," says Lazaros.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Nikolas, determined to leave no stone unturned, gathers the family at their new home. In front of everyone, he drops the bombshell: "Danai is not your daughter, Sotiris."

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Pavlos, now resolute, decides to focus solely on his marriage. "I want us to be happy, Nefeli... I don't care about your mother or anyone else," he declares, a sentiment overheard by Electra.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: A note slips under the door, a knife gleams in the dark. "For all the children in the world!" Orestis gazes at his killer, his eyes wide with astonishment.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Nikolas pressures Agni to visit a doctor in Athens, and she turns to the mayor for help. However, Sotiris is convinced that revealing the entire truth would utterly devastate Nikolas. Will she support Agni, or is this the moment for a final, devastating blow?

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: At the Mayor's house, Sotiris declares that he is reclaiming control: everyone will live together under one roof. Meanwhile, Nefeli, consumed by rage, takes an even more reckless step and goes to confront Perlepes.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Nefeli struggles to accept Sotiris' decision for all of them to live together and reacts intensely, while Pavlos faces a major confrontation with the mayor, finding himself caught in the crossfire.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Charis is going all out to get Domna released from prison. Pelopidas Vasiliou is determined to put her on trial for Michos's murder.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Sotiris is wracked with anxiety—without Michos' protection, who will stop the deputy minister from removing him from power?

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Sotiris is wracked with anxiety—without Michos' protection, who will stop the deputy minister from removing him from power?

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Pavlos holds a few handwritten pages. Offering them to Electra, he bares his soul. "I never stopped loving you," he confesses...

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Nikolas arrives at Sotiris' family home. In the basement, he finds someone lying motionless. His trembling hand reaches for their back…

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Electra is enduring her own torment, struggling to come to terms with how she and Pavlos were consumed by that initial, unparalleled feeling, only for everything to now unravel.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Meanwhile, Maro is the only one standing up for Sotiris as the island turns against him. How will Sotiris confront the angry mob?

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Pavlos stands before the painting of the river. "After what happened, I thought you would have turned him to ashes," he remarks to Electra. "I'll sell him for as much as I paid for him," she replies calmly.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Nikolas prepares to face a committee in hopes of leaving Agni's custody. Is it time to say goodbye... or not?

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Agni, turning to Bogris, delivers shocking news: "I'm pregnant." Bogris stares at her and asks, "Whose is it?"

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Danai is deeply shaken. Meanwhile, Electra realizes who Alkis is but chooses not to reveal it to anyone. Mother and daughter are both heartbroken.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Pavlos finds himself arguing with Lefteris. “You’re done,” Lefteris declares as he steps out. Electra follows, pleading, “I’ll give you as much as you want.” But unfortunately for Nefeli, she is already there—and she hears everything.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Electra asks Pavlos not to be there when she returns from the bank to meet Lefteris. “Today, I’m putting an end to everything,” she says. She has no idea that Nefeli already knows everything.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Danai tries to persuade Bogris to accept her proposed deal, while Nefeli finds Danai's letter and discovers the reason why she left...

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Nefeli unleashes her anger on her mother with such intensity that she leaves everyone stunned. In the heat of the moment, Pavlos slaps her in front of everyone, escalating the situation to its breaking point.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Stergios pleads with Titika to talk to Domna, to take action and help Electra. Will Domna agree? Is there still time?

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: A tender moment shared between Electra and Pavlos reminds Nikolas that he still holds an ace up his sleeve—one he has yet to play.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Nikolas follows the trail of Danai and Bogris, who have already arrived in Athens, now standing outside a church.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Vasilis confronts Konstantis, who confesses that he was bribed by Nikolas and shares a shocking truth about Stavros.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: At Bogris' house, Electra and Nikolas show up, only to face a shocking revelation: Danai is now his wife.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: An anonymous envelope slides under the office door. When Vasilis opens it, he realizes the stakes have risen dangerously high—he has become ensnared in the Mafia's web...

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Vasilis, Nikolas, and Nefeli each make life-altering decisions. What will Vassilis do about the shipyard, Nikolas with the incriminating photos, and Nefeli with the course of her own life?

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Vasilis arrives home to find Domna and Stergios talking with Giovanni. "Mio amico," Giovanni greets him with a smile, "why did you quit?" Vasilis feels his blood run cold...

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Vasilis falls into Giovanni's hands and is compelled to disclose the full extent of Stavros' blackmail.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Pavlos asks Nefeli for one last dance, while at home, Electra, shattered and a mere shadow of herself, struggles to cope. Meanwhile, Sotiris senses the danger closing in...

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Nefeli finds Pavlos still there. "Did you miss the boat?" she asks. Looking into her eyes, he tells her that he will stay, that he wants to fight for their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Pavlos sees that the atmosphere in the house is no longer welcoming, and once again tells Nefeli to leave.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Nefeli meets Vlasis, and for the first time, they neither fight nor argue. They just stare at each other, smiling for hours. Pavlos interrupts them, and for the first time he truly sees them.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Electra's disappearance after the attempt brings her worst fears to life. Nefeli, devastated and blaming herself for pushing Electra to it, struggles with guilt.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: With a trembling voice, Sotiris demands to know if Giovanni is holding her somewhere. Giovanni only laughs, sending a chill down Sotiris' spine.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Electra returns and the pieces of the puzzle slowly start to fall into place. But the truth is horrifying. "Stop, for God's sake! This can't be, it can't be, you're wrong!" Domna tells Electra, who can’t believe what her daughter is saying...

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: The island is in turmoil following Perlepe’s decision to forcibly send the young people to Alkimi. But Zoi is determined not to let it happen.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Giovanni stands across from Nikolas, eager to talk and find a solution. But Nikolas already has his solution in his pocket. He pulls out a pistol. However, the Italian never goes anywhere unarmed.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Electra has embraced a new approach, leaving everyone unable to recognize her. “What’s wrong with you, Electra?” Pavlos asks, but he doesn’t like her answer one bit.
